translation.name: ANWNV GAMLV
translation.englishName: Tagin first Bible translation based on TEV (Good News)

content: Nyirunv vdwv Jisunyi rinying toku
Vpap lwkmabv vtwng dvbamnam alu v nvchi toku, ho hum Vngbo dvmdvin vla minto.
Nyibu butvnv vdwv okv Pvbv tamsarnv vdwv nyi vdwa busu nyato, vkvlvgabv bunu Jisunyi tosila mvkidubv vla lamtv makar nyato.
Jisunyi Judas koa dukubv tolwk toku
Vbvrikunamv lvbwlaksu nyidum vring gola anyi lokv Judas, Iskeriot vla minam gvlo Uyu ngv aatoku.
Vbvrikunamv Judas Nyibu butvnv vdwgv okv Pwknvyarnvnaam ha kaayanv vdwgv nyigam gv dookulo nw Jisunyi oguaingbv bunu gvlo kublwk nyuku sengvdw ho lvga nga mintebv vngtoku.
Bunu mvngpula ninyia morko jidukubv mintoku.
Judas hum tolwk toku okv nw Jisunyi nyi chimpa madubv bunu gvlo laklwk dukubv vla alvnv dw marap toku.
Jisu vngbo dvmin dvdubv mvraprirap toku
Hoka vpap lwkmabv vtwng nga dvdw okv svlarkuu a vngbodvmin gv lvgabv palwkdw pumja alu v loolwk toku.
Jisu Pitar okv Jonnyi svbv mingvrila vngmuto: “Vngnyika okv ngonugv lvgabv vngbo dvmin dvnam a dvdubv mvpvripv tvka.”
Bunu ninyia tvvkato, “No ngonua ogolo mvpvripv tvka vla mvngdunv?”
Nw mirwkto, “Nonu gv pamtv vlo arwnglo aarilo, nyiga ako isi opum bvngnv go nonua vngrwksire. Ninyia vngming gvla ninyigv naam arwngbv aakulo aaming gvlaka,
okv naam atua minlaka: ‘Tamsarnv nam mindu, ngo okv ngoogv lvbwlaksu vdwgv vngbo dvmin dvnam dvjiku karchung ngv ogolo?’
Nw nonua aolo kaapu dubv mvnam karchung go kaatamre, hoka nonu ogumvnwng nga mvpvripv dukubv kaapare.”
Bunu vngtoku okv Jisu gv bunua minam aingbv ogumvnwngnga kaapa toku, okv bunu vngbo dvmin dvnam a mvpvripv toku.
Ahtu gv Dvtardvnya dvgvnam
Vdwlo dw v aato kudw, Jisu Apostol vdwa lvkobv dvkulo dootoku.
Nw bunua minto, “Ngoogv hinching chingma dwbv ngo nonua lvkobv so vngbo dvmin dvnam sum dvnwng dunv!
Ho lvga ngo nonua mindunv, Pwknvyarnv gv Karv lo so gv lvga nga alvbv rilin jima dvdvlo ngo vdwloka sum dvmare.”
Vbvrikunamv Jisu koobu a naarapto, Pwknvyarnvnyi umbonyikv vla minto, okv minto, “Sum naato okv nonugv apumlo nonu atu v ormisito.
Ngo nonua mindunv vjak lokv rila vdwlo Pwknvyarnv gv Karv ngv aama dvdvlo ngo vdwloka sum tvngnam sum tvngmare.”

Vbvrikunamv nw vtwng ariap ha naato, okv Pwknvyarnvnyi umbonyikv vla minto, hum pintungpiungto, okv hum bunua jitola, minto, “Si ngoogv ayak adwn v, sum nonugv lvgabv jipvnv. Ngam mvngpa gvnvbv sum rito laka.”
Ho apiabv, nw bunua dvnam dvro kochingbv koobu ha jitola, minto “So koobu si nonugv lvgabv ngoogv oyi sarlin kunamv si Pwknvyarnv gv anw bv milv jikunama mvu pvvku namv.”
“Vbvritola, kaatoka! ngam koanv angv vjak ngoogv dookulo tvbul si lvkobv doodu!
Nyia Kuunyilo ngv Pwknvyarnv gv minam aingbv sire, vbvritola vdwgo mvngdwk rekudw nga koanv angv!”
Vbvrikunamv bunugv apum lo tvvka minsu toku bunugv lokv yvvdw vbv ritv tvdunv vla.
Kaiyachoknam gv lvgabv larmisinam
Lvbwlaksu vdwv bunugv arwnglo larmi sinyato bunugv lokv yvv yadw kaiyachok nvgobv riji kunv vla.
Jisu bunua minto, “Pwknvyarnvnyi chimanv vdwgv Dvbv ngv bunugv nyi vdwa kaiyadunv, okv dvbv vdwv ‘Nyi vdwgv ajin’ vla amina gakdu.
Vbvritola so gv rinam si nonu gvlo doomare; vmabvya, nonu gvlo kaiyachok jinv ngv mvnwngnga miangyachok nvgobv rire okv rigvnv gubv rijinv pakbu aingbv rirungre.
Yvvla kainv, dvdubv vla dootungnv angv re vmalo ninyia jirianv angv re? Dootungnv angv, v rung. Vbvritola nonu gvlo ngo jirianv angv aingbv ridu.”
Ngo gv hirukaya kolo nonu nga lvkobv doomwng gvto;
okv ngoogv Abu nga rigv dubv jinam aingbv ngo nonua jidunv.
Nonu ngoogv Karv lo dvgianvnv lo doopv tvla dvriku okv tvngriku, okv Dvbv dogianvnv lo doopv tvla Israel gv nyi haalung vring gola anyia rigv reku.
Jisu Pitar gv mvvse nga mincho jitoku
“Saimon, Saimon! Tvriato! Uyu hv nonu mvnwngnga rika dubv vla rinv nvnga naagv nyibv, alvmanv lokv alv nvnga naapin sidubv vla, rongo rinv nyi ako gv aam-tami a amsok-misok lokv naapin sunam aingbv.
Vbvritola ngo nonugv lvgabv kumpvnv, Saimon, no gv mvngjwng ngv ngooma dubv. Okv vdwlo no nga dakrwk rikudw no noogv boru vdwa abwk mola kuka.”
Pitar mirwksito, “Ahtu, ngo nam lvkobv patwk tumjeka sida jeka reming gvdubv mvngpvla doodunv!”
“Pitar nam ngo mindunv,” Jisu minto, “Siyunyi rokpu v kokma dwbv no ngam chimapvnv vla lvomgo minre.”
Morko gvnvnv, Riokse, okv Kochak
Vbvrikunamv Jisu ninyigv lvbwlaksu vdwa tvvkato, “Ngoogv nonua morko gvnvnv, gvgianvnv vmalo lvsup jimabv vnglin mori hoka ogu chiimanvgo doopire?” “Oguka ma” bunu mirwkto.
“Vbvritola vjak,” Jisu minto, “Yvvdw morko gvnvnv vmalo gvgianvnv doodunv ung naarung toku laka; okv yvvdw riokse dooma dunv hv ninyigv vji laklwk a pioktola ako rvvla kuka.
Ngo nonua mindunv Darwknv Kitaplo mindu, ‘Nw rimur nvgv gungnying nga gvvria jito,’ vnam ngoogv lvga ngv jvjvbv aarung reku, ogulvgavbolo ngoogv lvga nga lvknam v jvjv bv rilin reku.”
Lvbwlaksu vdwv minto, “Kaatoka! Ahtu, So si riokse sonyi go doopv!” “Hv chipvku!”
nw mirwk toku.
Jisu Olib Moodw gv aolo kumtoku
Jisu pamtv nga vngyula vngtoku, ninyigv kvvlo gv vngchingbv, Olib Moodw lo; okv lvbwlaksu vdwv ninyia lvkobv vngto.
Vdwlo nw dooku hoka vngchi tokudw, nw bunua minto, “No pokayarka kolo ngoolwk madubv kumto laka.”
Vbvrikunamv nw bunua mego adubv vngyu dvla vlwng ngv kongchi dubv rikulo vngla nw lvbwng v kumpvto okv kumtoku.
“Abu” nw minto, “No mvngdu boloka, hinching gv koobu sam ngo gvlokv naapak jilabv. Ngoogv mvngnam bvma vbvritola noogv mvngnambv rilaka.”
Nyidomooku tolokv nyidogindung go ninyi gvlo aalwkto okv ninyia ridurto.
Achialvbv mvngdwk laila nw kadwk yayabv kumto; ninyigv haar hv oyi jvbv kvdw lo sarluto.
Kumku lokv taprap lakula, nw lvbwlaksu vdwgv dookulo aakur toku okv bunua yupngakla doodubv kaapa toku, mvngdwk hv bunua dwkyup gvdubv.
Nw bunua minto, “Ogubv nonu yupmin dunv? Gudungla kumla dootoka nonu gwngka kolo ngoolwk madubv.”
Jisunyi naatung kunam
Jisu gv raadung rilo nyipam go aalwkto, Judas, lvbwlaksu vring gola anyi lokv akonv aagvto. Nw Jisu gvlo chaato okv ninyia moopupto.
Vbvritola Jisu minto, “Judas, moopup akolo no Nyia Kuunyilo nga koa duku nvri?”
Vdwlo Jisunyi hoka lvkobv rinv vdwv ho gv ritv nama kaapa gvrila Jisunyi tvkato, “Ahtu ngonu ngonugv riokse lokv rirap svgo bri?”
Okv bunugv lokv akonv nyibu Butvyachok nvgv nyira nga nyarung rungbik ha palu toku.
Vbvritola Jisu minto, “So gotoku!” Nw nyi angv gv nyarung nga mvsit to okv ninyia mvpu toku.

Vbvrikunamv Jisu nyibu butvnv vdwa okv Pwknvyarnvnaam lo dakria nvgv nyigam vdwa okv nyiga vdw yvv ninyia naabv aanv vdwa minto, “Nonuno ngam Pvbv agumlo rinv nyi aing gubv, riokse okv daadwng bvngla aapvi?
Ngo Pwknvyarnvnaam lo loki a nonua lvkobv rebwngto, okv nonuno nga naatung dubv rikw mato. Vbvritola kanv gv gwlwk v rigvdogvri so, si nonugv ridw vku.”
Pitar Jisunyi chimakv vkunam
Bunu Jisunyi naatung toku okv ninyia Nyibu Butvyachok nvgv naam lo vnggv toku; okv Pitar mego adubv vngming gvto.
Kvba baaku naam gv adar lo vmv nga parto, okv Pitar hum dooyumnv vdwa doomwng gvto.
Vdwlo paknv akonv ninyia vmvlo doodubv kaapa tokudw, nw kaagap lalato ninyia okv minto, “So nyi angv si ka Jisu gv rikulo reming gvnv!”
Vbvritola Pitar hum miasuto, “Nyimv angv, ngo ninyia chimaka nvgo!”
Achukgo ayungjvma nga nyi akonv Pitarnyi kaachinto okv minto, “No ka bunugv lokv akonv!” Vbvritola Pitar mirwkto, “Nyi angv, ngo ma!”
Okv ayungjvma gv kochinglo nyi akonv ninyia minggap lala la minto, “Nw Jisunyi riming gvnv ngv vnam so mvngbwk masego kaama ogulvgavbolo nw ka Galili gv nyi go!”
Vbvritola Pitar mirwkto, “Nyi angv, no ogu gonyi mindudw ngo chima!” Vjakgobv, ninyigv vbv mindung rilo, rokpu v koktoku.
Ahtu kaitkarto okv Pitarnyi kaagapto, okv Pitar mvngpa toku Ahtu gv ninyia minam a, “Siyu gv ayulo rokpu v kokma dwbv no nga chima vla lvom go minre.”
Pitar agumbv vngtoku okv achialvbv mvngdwkla kaptoku.
Jisunyi nyarjinam okv dvngkunam
Jisunyi kaayanv nyi vdwv ninyia minjikminbikto okv ninyia dvngto.
Bunu ninyia nyik a putumto okv ninyi tvkato, “Yvvla nam dvngnv ngv? Mvngjwk kaato!”
Okv bunu ninyia nyarjikau gaam vkv awgo minto.
Jisunyi kvba baakulo daklin monam
Vdwlo bunu aato kudw, nyiga vdwv, nyibu butvnv vdwv, okv Pvbv tamsarnv vdwv lvkobv kaarwksuto, okv Jisunyi kvba vdwgv kaagialo daklin motoku.
Bunu minto, “Ngonua mintamto, no Kristo rungre?” Nw mirwkto, “Ngo nonua mintam jvka, nonu ngam mvngjwng mare;
Okv ngo nonua tvu sego tvka jvka nonu mirwk simare.
Vbvritola vjak lokv Nyia Kuunyilo ngv kaiyachoknv Pwknvyarnv gv lakbiklo dooreku.”
Bunu mvnwngngv mintoku, “Vbvrikunamv, no Pwknvyarnv gv Kuunyilo ngvre?” Nw bunua mirwkto, “Nonu gv minam hv ngo.”
Okv bunu minto, “Ngonu kvvbi gungnying yago mvngkuma! Nw ogugo minpvdw ngonu tvvgap tokubv!”

footnotes.text: Megonv kitaplo doomado Jisu gv gaamchar vdwv kochinglosi ngoogv ayakhv Bars 19, lo okv bars 20 gv mvnwnglo.
